field_semantics.status: Handoff status; keep original scientific RETURN_REPORT status unchanged in f0_return_report.
field_semantics.input_identities: Each available path, bytes, SHA256 and verified/missing state. Do not invent unknown sizes.
field_semantics.host_kind: Record actual local/NAVERCLOUD/other/unknown; do not infer from requested instance name.
field_semantics.new_tests: Actual command/exit/count and whether inherited or executed in this environment.
field_semantics.first_blocker: Null only when no blocker; preserve exception, phase, relevant log path without exposing secrets.
field_semantics.next_allowed_action: On F0 complete return result and stop. Native continuation needs separate implementation and run gates.
field_semantics.publication_or_backup_receipts: Empty when not performed. Do not equate local synchronized directory with provider ACK.
field_semantics.operator_admission: When not evaluated, use NOT_EVALUATED, not a fabricated boolean PASS or scientific FAIL.
